verdict.rationale: Gazebo provides key building blocks for CI simulation runs. It has a headless server-only mode (-s), a lightweight gz-sim-server package with no GUI or Qt dependencies, CLI tools for introspection and control, and remote, socket-based simulation via Gazebo Transport. However, nothing in the evidence documents a testing framework, CI integration, or a simulation-based regression-testing workflow. Missing for 10: documented test fixtures/APIs for automated tests, CI pipeline guidance or examples, regression-test tooling (assertions, deterministic replay, result reporting), independent corroboration of CI use.
